lines.zh: 冷水的边缘最好走，我沿着它。
lines.en: The cold water's edge suits me; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我从河里拐进海，盐味一下重了。
lines.en: I turn from river into sea and the salt sharpens.

lines.zh: 沙滩下的水浅，我贴着沙走。
lines.en: The water under the beach is shallow; I hug the sand.

lines.zh: 我们只有两条，一前一后。
lines.en: There are only two of us, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 我往上游走，水越走越凉。
lines.en: I head upstream and the water grows colder.

lines.zh: 我游过一片卵石，鳍擦出声。
lines.en: I cross a gravel bed and my fins rasp softly.

lines.zh: 海面结着薄冰，我在冰下走。
lines.en: Thin ice skins the sea; I travel beneath it.

lines.zh: 冷水让我的动作慢，但稳。
lines.en: Cold water slows me, but keeps me steady.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸线走，不往深处去。
lines.en: I follow the shoreline and keep to the shallows.

lines.zh: 河口的淡水推我，我顺着它。
lines.en: River-mouth fresh water pushes me and I yield.

lines.zh: 我回头看同伴，它还在。
lines.en: I glance back; my companion is still there.

lines.zh: 我拐过礁石，冷水从另一侧来。
lines.en: I round the reef and cold water comes from the far side.

lines.zh: 上游的水急，我走之字形。
lines.en: Upstream runs fast, so I go in zigzags.

lines.zh: 我走过一段沙，尾巴留下浅痕。
lines.en: Across a sand bar, my tail leaves a faint line.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰下的暗水往上游走。
lines.en: I head upstream along the dark water under the ice.

lines.zh: 我拐进河湾，水一下子缓了。
lines.en: I turn into the bend and the current slows.

lines.zh: 我抬了一下背鳍，越过浅坎。
lines.en: I lift my dorsal fin and cross the shallow rise.

lines.zh: 两条影子贴着沙，一起挪。
lines.en: Two shadows slide along the sand together.

lines.zh: 冷水里我几乎不动，省力气。
lines.en: In cold water I barely move, saving strength.

lines.zh: 我悬在冰下的光里，很静。
lines.en: I hang in the light under the ice, very still.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼经过，我没有追。
lines.en: A small fish passes and I do not chase.

lines.zh: 我身上那层粉，在水里更淡了。
lines.en: My pink tint looks paler down here.

lines.zh: 我听着河口的浪，一下一下。
lines.en: I listen to the estuary surf, wave by wave.

lines.zh: 沙粒落在我背上，我懒得甩。
lines.en: Sand settles on my back; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我只有三条命，所以很小心。
lines.en: I have only three hearts, so I am careful.

lines.zh: 冷水泡久了，我的鳍有点僵。
lines.en: After long cold soaking my fins stiffen.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水转向。
lines.en: I am waiting for the tide to turn.

lines.zh: 河与海在这里混着，味道怪。
lines.en: River and sea mix here, and the taste is odd.

lines.zh: 我很少单独待着，两条正好。
lines.en: I am rarely alone; two is just right.

lines.zh: 水面反光，我看不清上面。
lines.en: The surface glare hides what is above.

lines.zh: 我数着游过去的水母，一个。
lines.en: I count the jellyfish drifting by: one.

lines.zh: 就这样待着，直到水变暖。
lines.en: I stay like this until the water warms.

lines.zh: 我把身子斜过来，让水流过鳃。
lines.en: I tilt my body and let the current pass my gills.

lines.zh: 河底的石头很凉，我不动。
lines.en: The river stones are cold. I stay still.

lines.zh: 你在沙滩上走，我从水里看你。
lines.en: You walk the beach; I watch from the water.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，冷空气刺了一下鳃。
lines.en: I lift my head and cold air stings my gills.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在浅水上，我停住。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the shallows and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但你没有拿网。
lines.en: I do not know you, but you hold no net.

lines.zh: 我转了半圈，让你看清我的侧线。
lines.en: I turn half around to show you my flank.

lines.zh: 你蹲在冰边，冰下有我的影子。
lines.en: You crouch at the ice; my shadow lies beneath it.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看你，你隔着冰看我。
lines.en: I see you through water, you through ice.

lines.zh: 我们两条一起抬头，又一起低下。
lines.en: Both of us look up, then both look away.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在水面上成了白雾。
lines.en: Your breath turns to white mist above the water.

lines.zh: 我退到冷水深处，那里更安心。
lines.en: I withdraw to the colder deep, where I feel safer.

lines.zh: 你要是不动，我就再看一会儿。
lines.en: If you keep still, I will watch a while longer.

lines.zh: 我认得冷，也认得站在冷里的人。
lines.en: I know cold, and I know those who stand in it.

lines.zh: 我的侧线被划开，水灌进来。
lines.en: My flank is cut open and water floods in.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了半条命。
lines.en: That one cost me half a life.

lines.zh: 我往冰下钻，那里没有网。
lines.en: I dive beneath the ice, where there are no nets.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出的血，半天才淡。
lines.en: Blood from the wound takes half a day to thin.

lines.zh: 我翻过来又翻回去，鳍在抖。
lines.en: I roll over and back, fins trembling.

lines.zh: 你打中我的尾柄，我游不快了。
lines.en: You hit my tail base and I cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 别踩，我在你脚边的浅水里。
lines.en: Do not step; I am in the shallows by your feet.

lines.zh: 我疼得忘记该往哪边逃。
lines.en: Pain makes me forget which way to flee.

lines.zh: 同伴已经跑了，我还在原地。
lines.en: My companion has fled; I am still here.

lines.zh: 三条命不经打，一下少了半条。
lines.en: Three hearts are fragile; one hit takes half.

lines.zh: 那味道穿过冷水，一直到我这里。
lines.en: That smell cuts through cold water all the way to me.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西，我绕着你走。
lines.en: You hold something, so I circle you.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，冷水让我更饿。
lines.en: I have been hungry long, and cold makes it worse.

lines.zh: 你往水里扔一粒，我就往前一寸。
lines.en: Toss one piece in and I advance an inch.

lines.zh: 同伴先动了，我才跟上去。
lines.en: My companion moves first; then I follow.

lines.zh: 那东西在动，比死的好吃。
lines.en: It wriggles, which beats anything dead.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是河口的味道，很熟。
lines.en: I smell the estuary, and it is familiar.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了试水温，又闭上。
lines.en: I open my mouth, test the water, and shut it.

lines.zh: 你再近一点，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Come one step closer and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 冷水里的食物最少，我不挑。
lines.en: Cold water offers little; I cannot be choosy.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子游，不敢咬。
lines.en: I swim along your shadow, not daring to bite.

lines.zh: 你手心朝上，那是给的意思吧。
lines.en: Your palm faces up, which must mean an offer.

lines.zh: 我绕了三圈，还是没敢上前。
lines.en: Three times around, and still I hold back.

lines.zh: 要是你收手，我会记住这件事。
lines.en: If you take it back, I will remember that.

lines.zh: 你手指一动，我就退半寸。
lines.en: Your finger moves and I retreat half an inch.

lines.zh: 这一小团，够我吃一整天。
lines.en: This little clump could feed me all day.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的小腿，凉了一下。
lines.en: I bump your calf and feel a chill.

lines.zh: 冰太薄，我撞碎了它才出来。
lines.en: The ice was thin; I broke through it to reach you.

lines.zh: 两条鱼挤同一条缝，我被顶开。
lines.en: Two fish, one crevice; I get squeezed out.

lines.zh: 我碰到网边，立刻退了回来。
lines.en: I touch the net edge and recoil at once.

lines.zh: 你踩着沙走过来，水推了我一把。
lines.en: You walk across the sand and your wake shoves me.

lines.zh: 我没看见你，冷水里太暗。
lines.en: I did not see you; cold water is dim.

lines.zh: 鳞片蹭过你的裤脚，留下水痕。
lines.en: My scales brush your trouser leg and leave a wet mark.

lines.zh: 撞一下不疼，我怕的是后面的网。
lines.en: The bump does not hurt; the net behind it does.

lines.zh: 我让开半尺，你正好走过去。
lines.en: I give half a foot and you walk right past.

lines.zh: 这条河道窄，我们总会碰上。
lines.en: This channel is narrow; we are bound to meet.

lines.zh: 我往上游走，是为了找浅滩。
lines.en: I head upstream to find a shallow gravel bed.

lines.zh: 我们把卵埋进沙里，用尾巴扇平。
lines.en: We bury the eggs in sand and fan it flat.

lines.zh: 她体侧泛红，我知道时候到了。
lines.en: Her flank flushes red; I know the time has come.

lines.zh: 两条鱼守着一小片水，够了。
lines.en: Two fish guarding one small patch is enough.

lines.zh: 冷水让卵孵得慢，我们不急。
lines.en: Cold water slows the eggs; we are in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，水底的沙浮起来。
lines.en: I circle her and the bottom sand lifts.

lines.zh: 上游的水太急，我们换了个弯。
lines.en: Upstream ran too fast, so we took a bend.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去，让她贴着。
lines.en: I turn my side to her so she can press close.

lines.zh: 这是我们第一次走到这么远。
lines.en: This is the first time we have come this far.

lines.zh: 等卵沉下去，我们再回海里。
lines.en: Once the eggs settle, we return to the sea.

lines.zh: 你把我捞出冷水，我僵了一下。
lines.en: You lift me from the cold and I go stiff.

lines.zh: 桶里的水不够凉，我贴着桶底。
lines.en: The bucket water is not cold enough; I press low.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下，水溅到你脸上。
lines.en: I thrash once and water hits your face.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度让我不舒服。
lines.en: The warmth of your palm bothers me.

lines.zh: 离水太久，我的粉会褪。
lines.en: Out of water too long, my pink fades.

lines.zh: 你把我翻过来看，我拍了两下。
lines.en: You turn me over to look; I slap twice.

lines.zh: 我记得冰下的光，这里没有。
lines.en: I remember light under the ice; there is none here.

lines.zh: 放我回去，那段河我还没游完。
lines.en: Put me back; I have not finished that stretch of river.

lines.zh: 桶壁很滑，我找不到边。
lines.en: The bucket wall is slippery; I find no edge.

lines.zh: 你提着我走，冷风从上面来。
lines.en: You carry me off and cold wind comes from above.

lines.zh: 你踩碎冰面，我立刻沉下去。
lines.en: You crack the ice and I drop at once.

lines.zh: 水一凉，我就知道有人来了。
lines.en: The water cools and I know someone has come.

lines.zh: 有影子压过来，我抬头看清了。
lines.en: A shadow presses down; I look up and see you.

lines.zh: 你手里那根线，我吃过亏。
lines.en: That line in your hand has cost me before.

lines.zh: 我不冲，先往深处退两尺。
lines.en: I do not charge; I back two feet deeper first.

lines.zh: 你站在浅滩，把水搅浑了。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows and muddy the water.

lines.zh: 我盯住你手里的东西，不是你。
lines.en: I fix on what you hold, not on you.

lines.zh: 同伴躲进石缝，我留在外面。
lines.en: My companion hides in the rocks; I stay out.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在水里传得远。
lines.en: Your footsteps carry far through the water.

lines.zh: 我记住你的位置，然后游开。
lines.en: I mark where you are, then swim off.

lines.zh: 我保持在这个距离，不近不远。
lines.en: I hold this distance, neither near nor far.

lines.zh: 冷水让我慢，我干脆等。
lines.en: Cold slows me, so I simply wait.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，水会先动。
lines.en: When you turn, the water moves first.

lines.zh: 我贴着石缝的边看你。
lines.en: I watch you from the edge of the crevice.

lines.zh: 我不叫，冷水里声音传不远。
lines.en: I stay quiet; sound does not carry in cold water.

lines.zh: 我们两条分开，从两边看你。
lines.en: The two of us split and watch from both sides.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就往下沉半尺。
lines.en: You raise a hand and I sink half a foot.

lines.zh: 我算着你还能站多久。
lines.en: I am counting how long you can stand there.

lines.zh: 你的影子一直跟着我，我不动。
lines.en: Your shadow keeps following me; I hold still.

lines.zh: 再等一会儿，我就要走了。
lines.en: A little longer and I will leave.

lines.zh: 我撞开你的手，没用牙。
lines.en: I knock your hand aside without using teeth.

lines.zh: 我的嘴小，咬不出血。
lines.en: My mouth is small; it draws no blood.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口水草，咬偏了。
lines.en: I bite the weeds; my aim was off.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我撞在你手腕上。
lines.en: You raise your arm and I hit your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下力气不大，我只有三条命。
lines.en: It is a weak blow; I have only three hearts.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴抽水，溅你一脸。
lines.en: I slap the water with my tail and splash you.

lines.zh: 咬完我就退进冷水里。
lines.en: After the bite I retreat into the cold.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖口，被拖了半步。
lines.en: I catch your sleeve and get dragged half a step.

lines.zh: 你要是不追，我就停在这里。
lines.en: If you do not chase, I stop right here.

lines.zh: 冷水里打架，谁都讨不到好。
lines.en: A fight in cold water suits nobody.

lines.zh: 我在上游的浅滩出生。
lines.en: I was born in a shallow bed upstream.

lines.zh: 卵在沙里待了一冬，才孵出来。
lines.en: The eggs waited a whole winter in the sand.

lines.zh: 一窝里只有我们两条。
lines.en: Only two of us came from that spawning.

lines.zh: 水很冷，我出生就学会了忍。
lines.en: The water was cold; I learned patience at birth.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，天是白的。
lines.en: I broke out of the sand into a white sky.

lines.zh: 权重只有六，所以我少见。
lines.en: My weight is only six, so I am rarely seen.

lines.zh: 我走的第一条路，是往海里去。
lines.en: My first road led toward the sea.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着卵壳的味道。
lines.en: I still carry the smell of the eggshell.

lines.zh: 沙滩和冷水，我选后者。
lines.en: Between beach and cold water, I chose the cold.

lines.zh: 三条命，从这段浅滩开始。
lines.en: Three hearts, starting from this shallow bed.

lines.zh: 火烤到水面，冷水也挡不住。
lines.en: Fire reaches the surface; even cold water fails.

lines.zh: 浪把我推上沙滩，我拍了两下尾。
lines.en: The wave throws me ashore and I flop twice.

lines.zh: 我的鳃被沙堵住，冷水也没用了。
lines.en: Sand clogs my gills; cold water cannot help.

lines.zh: 爆炸震得水面发白，我昏了一下。
lines.en: The blast whitens the surface and stuns me.

lines.zh: 箭穿过冰面，扎在我旁边的沙里。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the ice and sticks beside me.

lines.zh: 魔法贴上来，我的鳞片全竖了。
lines.en: Magic touches me and every scale stands.

lines.zh: 冷天找不到食，我只能啃沙。
lines.en: No food in the cold; I end up chewing sand.

lines.zh: 雷打在冰上，整片水都亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the ice and the water lights up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有冷水，我也不冷了。
lines.en: The void has no cold water, and I feel no cold.
